milestones.title: Oops, Committed
milestones.joke: A secret in git. It happens to everyone.
milestones.when: shell: the lab's first `git commit` inside a repo (exit 0); it can't see the file's content, only that a commit happened

milestones.title: Scanner Darkly
milestones.when: shell: `gitleaks` exits non-zero, which is how it reports a finding

milestones.title: Pre-Commit Bouncer
milestones.joke: A hook now stops the next leak.
milestones.when: shell: a `git commit` that fails after a scan found the leak (the hook refusing it; a commit that fails for another reason also counts)
